summary: Unpinned GitHub dependency pulls code from a third-party repository at install
details: package.json declares the runtime dependency `libsignal` as `github:tenka-san/libsignal-node` — a bare GitHub repo reference with no commit SHA, tag, or integrity hash. On `npm install`, the package manager clones whatever bytes the repository's default branch holds at that moment and installs them as a dependency of this package, running any lifecycle scripts contained in the fetched tree. The source is a third-party GitHub account, not the npm registry, and the fetched contents are unpinned and mutable: any future push to that repository's default branch flows into every subsequent install of @xzvbailss/baileys@5.0.0. The package name also mimics the widely used `baileys` WhatsApp library, increasing the likelihood of accidental installation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
